meta.name: agent-cli
meta.description: Add agent-friendly --json NDJSON output to Python CLI scripts, or scaffold a complete cli_utils package for a project. Use this skill when the user wants to make scripts machine-readable for AI agents, add --json flags, convert print statements to structured JSON, build a CLI helper library, create an open-source CLI-for-agents package, add structured logging, or make CLI output machine-readable. Also use when the user mentions NDJSON, structured CLI output, agent-friendly CLI, non-interactive scripts, or JSON I/O for automation.
